selection_rules.condition: The customer operates a hospital or clinic.
selection_rules.action: Select candidates based on the services and website scope confirmed by the customer.

selection_rules.condition: The customer operates a diagnostic laboratory.
selection_rules.action: Determine whether the laboratory serves consumers directly, accepts provider referrals, or both.

selection_rules.condition: The customer operates a healthcare marketplace.
selection_rules.action: Identify both sides of the marketplace, the administrator role, and any additional participants confirmed by the customer.

selection_rules.condition: The customer operates an RPM or connected-care service.
selection_rules.action: Confirm which users interact with devices, readings, alerts, care teams, and support.

selection_rules.condition: The customer manufactures or sells medical devices.
selection_rules.action: Confirm product users, purchasing decision-makers, distributors, service teams, and support needs.

selection_rules.condition: The customer offers telehealth or behavioral health services.
selection_rules.action: Confirm the care model, supported communication channels, appointment process, and applicable privacy requirements.

selection_process: Identify the website's primary business objective.
Generate candidate personas using the relevant selection rules.
Ask which audiences the organization actually serves.
Identify primary, secondary, and out-of-scope audiences.
Map confirmed audiences to website journeys and required features.
Label any unconfirmed persona or behavior as a hypothesis.

priority_rules.primary: Directly connected to the website's principal business objective.
priority_rules.secondary: Important to the service or business but not the primary conversion audience.
priority_rules.operational: Uses internal or restricted tools to deliver or administer the service.
priority_rules.out_of_scope: Not served by the current website or product scope.

clarification_triggers: The business model supports multiple possible audience types.
The website may include both public pages and authenticated portals.
A user may view, submit, or change patient information.
The proposed journey involves clinical decisions or patient safety.
The proposed feature requires identity verification or delegated access.
The customer has not specified the primary conversion goal.
